label: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S1 (esp. a2->S1 rare), early-episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), on about 15% of D1 steps. Rate is highest when the previous trial was rare (2.3x) and unrewarded (1.6x), after an a2 choice (1.5x), and when S2 is the good state (1.5x). The strongest windows are runs of a2 -> S1 rare, unrewarded, with activation growing over consecutive such trials, so it looks like it integrates evidence over several trials (S1 not paying, S2 favoured). The feature also falls off steadily with episode trial: about 2x early, near zero after trial 80. It is concentrated at mid-range value (7.1-7.7). The recorded predicate uses only observed variables: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S1 (dev P 0.49, R 0.45, F1 0.47, mass recall 0.52). Adding prev_action==2 or rare-transition clauses plus ep_trial<70 pushes F1 to about 0.50 at most. Phase alone (D1) gets mass recall 1.0 but precision only 0.15. Many activations come from other histories (e.g. weak firing after rewarded S2 trials early in the episode), so this is only a partial account.
